title: Approach and Stop at a Station
description: Use power, then braking, to reach standstill and confirm the stopped indication.

steps.instruction: Apply P1 to begin a simulated approach under controlled conditions.
Use the speedometer to confirm a speed of at least 2 km/h.
Select B2 to make a service-brake request and watch train speed decrease.
Observe the speedometer reaching standstill; do not assume the train stops immediately after selecting B2.
Return the master handle to N at standstill and explain the checks that would precede door operation.

learningObjective: Understand controlled slowing and the need to verify standstill before door procedures.
operatingConditions: A practice stop only: the simulator does not implement a validated stopping marker or real station approach authority.
No passenger door operation until stopped.
expectedObservations: The train gains speed after P1.
The speedometer eventually indicates standstill before any door activity.
debriefQuestions: Why does braking have to begin before the desired stop?
Can this exercise verify exact stopping accuracy at a platform marker?
